title: Lost ID Card and Request for Base Card
topic: Lost ID Card and Request for Base Card
executive_summary: Two people talk about the principal of the Babu Matanka Inter College and ask for a check from their karmi to pay for the BA paper, which was missing from their school. They mention that they lost their ID card from their hand and need an ID card from the base card and a photo of the person who is coming with the base card. They also mention that they need money and a document.
key_points: Lost ID Card and Request for Base Card
